title: Clean SRD audit check and typecheck output
description:
Clean non-blocking audit command-output diagnostics before future SRD bundles.

Problem:
The ngcj bundle passes check/typecheck/test/verify, but captured command output still includes non-blocking diagnostic noise, including a Biome schema-version info diagnostic in npm run check output. This is not a correctness blocker, but it adds review noise and makes future audit bundles harder to scan.

Scope:
- Identify why the Biome schema-version info diagnostic appears.
- Align the Biome config schema/version with the CLI version used in the repo.
- Confirm npm run check and npm run typecheck output is clean apart from expected command banners.
- Do not suppress real diagnostics.

Acceptance criteria:
- npm run check exits 0 without the Biome schema-version info diagnostic.
- npm run typecheck exits 0 and remains clean.
- npm test passes.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack passes.
- Future audit command-output artifacts are easier to review and do not contain known benign noise.
close_reason: Completed in branch eshyra-vk23-rest: gameplay-readiness partial-structure reporting, clean Biome 2.5.1 check output, and SRD option source-page attribution.
